visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair and a grey knit beanie sits on a brown tufted leather sofa. She is dressed in a black turtleneck. In front of her is a cushion featuring a large beagle face. She holds a smartphone, gesturing excitedly as she speaks to the camera in a brightly lit indoor room. (2) The camera zooms in for an extreme close-up of the woman's eyes and forehead as she stares directly into the lens with an exaggerated, wide-eyed expression. Her skin is clear, and her bangs are neatly trimmed. The background is blurred, focusing entirely on her intense facial expression. (3) A close-up view of the smartphone screen held by the woman. The OpenPoint app interface is visible, showing various promotional banners and a point balance of 149.31 P. A finger with purple and white nail art taps and scrolls through the menu options to select point redemption features. (4) A full-screen graphic list appears over a dark, out-of-focus street background. The list, numbered 1 through 5, outlines various payment options like general shopping, parking fees, and taxes. The text is in white Traditional Chinese characters, clearly presented for the viewer to read as instructions. (5) Returning to the woman on the sofa, she smiles broadly and makes a "money" gesture with her hands. Animated cartoon graphics of banknotes and dollar signs float and fall across the screen, creating a celebratory and lucrative atmosphere while she continues to explain the benefits. (6) The shot shifts as a hand enters from the left frame, holding a blue and white parking ticket. The woman, still on the sofa, looks toward the ticket and reaches out her hand, which features a silver watch and bracelet, to take the document from the person off-camera. (7) The scene transitions to a 7-Eleven retail counter. The woman's hands hold the phone and the ticket, presenting a QR code to a scanner. The store environment is visible with green signage and promotional materials on the counter. A clerk's hand is partially visible during the transaction process. (8) The woman stands outdoors against a bright yellow-tiled wall. She wears a denim jacket over her black turtleneck and continues her beanie. She points at her phone screen, which shows a reduced point balance, confirming the successful payment of the bill. (9) The camera pans to a wide shot of a city sidewalk. A man in a black jacket walks away quickly, holding the paid ticket. The woman begins to run after him, shouting and waving her arms. The background includes street signs, parked cars, and a storefront with red lanterns. (10) The final shot is a tight close-up of the woman's face. She has a neutral, somewhat confused or deadpan expression as she looks slightly off-center. The lighting is natural and bright, highlighting her features and the texture of her knit beanie before the video ends.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 90%的人都不知道. [Logo]: OpenPoint. (2) [Subtitle]: OpenPoint的點數. (3) [Subtitle]: 可以直接折抵帳單. (4) [Subtitle]: 只要2個步驟. (5) [Subtitle]: 超簡單! (6) [Subtitle]: 首先打開OpenPoint的App. (7) [Subtitle]: 點選右上方會員條碼. (8) [Subtitle]: 選擇點數折抵的選項. (9) [Subtitle]: 你看我現在可用點數. (10) [Subtitle]: 有149.31 P點. (11) [Subtitle]: 1點就能折抵1元. (12) [Subtitle]: 底下這些通通都能折抵. (13) [Slogan]: 1. 一般商品消費 (菸品除外) 2. 繳費 (EX. 停車費) 3. 繳稅 (EX. 綜所稅) 4. 代售 (EX. 垃圾袋) 5. 電商包裹、交貨便. (14) [Subtitle]: 簡單來說這些買東西回饋的點數就是送你的. (15) [Subtitle]: 而累積的點數又等同於現金. (16) [Subtitle]: 像是一般商品的消費, 停車費, 電信費, 罰單, 還有繳稅. (17) [Subtitle]: 電商平台包裹, 通通都能用. (18) [Subtitle]: 簡直就是賺到欸! (19) [Subtitle]: 那我這剛好有一張要試試看嗎? (20) [Subtitle]: 好, 我想要繳停車費, 我可以用這個折抵嗎? (21) [Variety]: (可以). (22) [Subtitle]: 欸Ya成功了. (23) [Subtitle]: 欸我們實測完沒想到真的可以繳費欸. (24) [Subtitle]: 那就謝囉掰. (25) [Subtitle]: 欸還我NT$20.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a cheerful female voice speaking at a moderate conversational pace. An upbeat, rhythmic electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 beat and synth textures plays at a low volume. The speaker’s tone is energetic and welcoming, set in a quiet indoor environment. (2) The female narrator continues her instructional speech, maintaining a high pitch and clear articulation. The BGM tempo remains consistent around 124 BPM. No background noise is audible, suggesting a clean recording environment. The vocal delivery is focused and persuasive as she explains the app points. (3) A male voice interjects with a friendly, casual tone, asking a question about the parking ticket. The BGM continues without interruption. The transition between the two speakers is smooth, with the male voice appearing slightly more distant, likely recorded in the same room. (4) A sharp, high-pitched electronic 'beep' sound effect occurs, signifying the scanning of the phone’s QR code at the retail counter. The ambient noise floor shifts slightly to include subtle shop sounds, though the primary signal remains the upbeat BGM and the woman's excited confirmation. (5) A bright, synthesized 'Ding' sound effect plays, punctuating the success of the transaction. The female voice rises in pitch and volume, expressing excitement. The BGM swells slightly in volume, matching the positive emotional arousal of the scene as the transaction completes successfully. (6) The recording location shifts outdoors, evidenced by a slight change in the ambient noise floor, which now includes distant urban hum. The woman’s voice remains clear and projected as she summarizes the experiment. The BGM continues to drive the rhythm of the presentation. (7) The audio environment becomes chaotic as the woman begins to shout loudly after the man. Her vocal arousal is high, with a sharp, strained quality. A stylized 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the visual movement of the chase. The male voice is heard briefly as he walks away. (8) The upbeat BGM suddenly cuts out, leading to a moment of strategic silence during the final close-up shot. There is no speech or SFX, creating a stark contrast to the previous high-energy shouting. The audio ends on this silent, low-arousal note.
